faq_heading: Central Park houses: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for houses in Central Park. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Central Park, Burnaby: 9 houses listed at the end of October 2026 and 1 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 11% on only 9 listed, too few to read as a market type. By listings that is number 23 of 35 Burnaby communities for houses.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Burnaby total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in Central Park fell from 12 in June to 9 in October (−25.0%), and 7 sold across the 5 months. In October the community held 2.1% of Burnaby’s 430 houses listed.
Houses or condos and townhomes in Central Park?
Central Park also had 25 condos and townhomes listed and 2 sold in October, against 9 houses listed. The Central Park condos and townhomes page has those figures.

blocks.text: Central Park home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

10 houses sold in Central Park with a median price of $1,925,500 (the middle half sold between $1,617,000 and $2,200,000), taking a median of 14 days to sell at 91.3% of the last list price; 10% sold above list. They had a median $808 per square foot, a median year built of 1954 and a median lot of 7,096 square feet.

blocks.source: Source: Paragon, the MLS® system used by Jared’s office, closed sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026. Pending sales are not counted. Median means the middle price, so half sold for more and half for less. Sold vs list is the sale price as a percentage of the last list price. A figure is shown only where at least 5 homes sold, and a row is shown only with 5 or more sales; with fewer, one sale would be the whole figure.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Central Park?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 9 houses listed in Central Park. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Central Park a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses in Central Park had a sales ratio of 11% on only 9 listed, too few to read as a market type. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Central Park from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 7 houses sold in Central Park over those 5 months, out of 251 in all of Burnaby.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Central Park?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.q: What did houses in Central Park sell for?
faq.a: 10 houses sold in Central Park between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,925,500.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Central Park?
faq.a: The median was 14 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 91.3% of the last list price (10% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
